description: Angular component for configuring Flot chart widget settings in Thingsboard UI, including form controls, validation, and dynamic behavior based on chart type.

classes.name: FlotWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing flot chart widget settings, including form initialization, validation, and dynamic control enabling/disabling based on chart type.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls and subscriptions for form value changes and validation.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form controls with provided settings value.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates changes.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables validators based on current form state and chart type.

methods.name: dataKeysListForLabelsFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array for data keys list.

methods.name: trackByLabelDataKey
methods.description: Track function for label data key controls.

methods.name: removeLabelDataKey
methods.description: Removes a label data key control at specified index.

methods.name: addLabelDataKey
methods.description: Adds a new label data key control.

methods.name: labelDataKeyDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop reordering of label data keys.
